meta.title: Food Chaining - EatPal
meta.description: Plan small steps from the foods your child already eats toward new ones, one change at a time.

shell.title: Food Chaining
shell.whoseChains: Whose chains? Pick a child to see their next small step.
shell.noKids: Add a child to start a chain
shell.ladderNone: See where {{kid}}'s foods sit on the ladder

explainer.line1: Start from a food your child already eats.
explainer.line2: Each next link changes one thing about it: the taste, the texture, the color or the shape.
explainer.line3: Offer a link a few times before moving on. A refusal is part of learning, not a failure.
explainer.example: For example: plain pasta, then buttered pasta, then pasta with a little sauce.
